ache.title: His first hit video, and it’s about running out of jades
ache.note: Nero’s first hit was a plan to ‘understand the potential of your account’ so you don’t run out of Stellar Jades for the characters you want. The whole plan exists because the game keeps you short. A meta plan feels like control, but it turns every banner into something you have to manage.
watch: endgame that writes your shopping list
fear of running out of jades
ache.tip: Your account has no ‘potential’ to live up to. Play the characters you like and skip content that demands more.
lines: his first success. he did a little dance, I bet
your account isn’t behind. it’s just an account
